cache.scope: caller-thread Hibernate StatementInspector; excludes SQL on HTTP/background threads; one cold read then 99 warm hits

sameSlotHolds.scope: identical start AND end time hold creation only; not full booking oversell safety

fixedWindowLimiter.scope: real Redis fixed-window primitive; not HTTP endpoint rate-limit thresholds

knownConcurrencyDiagnostics.scope: real Redis service calls, not persisted booking writes; failures are reported, not hidden

kafka.scope: healthy single-broker synthetic event fan-out; notification logs only, not delivered emails or crash/exactly-once testing
